name: competitive-intel
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs autonomous competitive intelligence: tracks your competitors across LinkedIn, news, reviews, job postings, and regulatory signals, then writes an executive brief and per-competitor sales battlecards on a schedule.
author: Brittany Slay (https://brittanyslay.com)

gmail_user.description: Gmail address used to send the brief and alerts

gmail_app_password.description: Gmail App Password (not your real password) — generate at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

brave_api_key.description: Optional Brave Search API key — improves search quality. Free tier: 2,000 queries/month at brave.com/search/api

competitor_list.description: Competitor names or domains to track in every run (or set them in competitors.json)
